ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Feeding Our Future Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and funding of Feeding Our Future to uncover the extent of the fraud and identify those involved.
questions: What were the sources of funding for Feeding Our Future?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and funding of Feeding Our Future, we may be able to identify a larger scheme involving multiple individuals and organizations. This investigation could lead to further revelations about corruption and abuse of funds.
